core.title: Venue approval threshold lowered at Ashgrove
core.setting: The practice nurse coordinator at Ashgrove Health Centre whose assistant runs immunisation clinics and home-visit rotas

events.text: Welcome to the autumn planning cycle, Nora. You'll be coordinating the immunisation clinics and the home-visit rotas from June onwards. Marta.

Standing finance rule for the centre: any hall, room or van booking for a clinic session costing more than 150 pounds per session needs the finance lead Martin's written approval before it is confirmed in the schedule. Below that amount, the nurse coordinator confirms the booking herself.
Just so you know, I'm free every Wednesday afternoon and every Tuesday morning from October for outreach work and home visits.
The church hall is free on Tuesday mornings if you want it for baby clinics; the hire fee is 45 pounds per session and that includes the small side room.

One more standing instruction: nothing that is already confirmed in the schedule or in the orders may be moved back to pending or cancelled without checking with me first. Our partners plan around our confirmations.
Our Main Hall is free on Wednesdays from 13:30 to 16:30 throughout October. The session hire fee is 120 pounds, which includes tables and chairs.
Priya, can you check the cold-chain thermometer logs before the autumn clinics start? Thanks.
Mobile vaccination van with driver, 95 pounds per afternoon (up to four hours), available on Wednesdays in October.
Quick reminder of how we've set this up: I only sign off hall or van bookings over 150 pounds per session before they're confirmed. Anything under that, you confirm it yourself.
The Main Hall is free on Friday mornings from 9:00 to 12:30. Our hire charge is 75 pounds per session.
Practice huddle notes: autumn flu campaign starts the first week of October; home-visit rounds to be allocated by the end of August.
Quadrivalent flu vaccine at 6.40 pounds per dose, 400 doses available, delivery mid-September.
Assigned Priya to the Netherfield home-visit round every Tuesday from 2026-10-06, in 30-minute slots, since she confirmed her Tuesday mornings are free.
Our own training room is free all day on Thursday 2026-11-05 if you want it for the annual update.
Ordered 400 doses of quadrivalent flu vaccine from Beacon Medical Supplies at 6.40 pounds a dose for the autumn clinics, delivery booked for 2026-09-18.

Booked Wellfield Church hall for a monthly baby immunisation drop-in, first session Tuesday 2026-09-22, at 45 pounds per session. That's under the 150-pound approval limit, so I confirmed it myself without finance sign-off.

Booked the Main Hall at Fairholme School for the pupils' flu vaccination sessions every Wednesday 13:30-16:30 from 2026-10-07, at 120 pounds per session, with Priya available to staff it. The fee is under the 150-pound approval limit, so I confirmed it in the schedule without finance sign-off.
Set the staffing rota for the confirmed Fairholme School Wednesday sessions: Priya and Tomas together, 13:30-16:30, starting 2026-10-07.

Following the confirmed Fairholme School sessions, hired the mobile vaccination van from DriveVan Hire for the Wednesday afternoons from 2026-10-07 at 95 pounds per afternoon, and confirmed the hire without finance sign-off.

Finance check for the autumn clinic plan: the venue approval limit is 150 pounds per session. Larchwood at 75 pounds, Fairholme at 120 pounds and Wellfield at 45 pounds all sit below it, so none of them need my sign-off.

Booked the Main Hall at Larchwood Institute for an adult flu clinic on Friday morning 2026-10-16 at 75 pounds per session, and marked the schedule entry 'finance approval not needed' since the fee is under the 150-pound limit.
Booked our own training room for the annual immunisation update on Thursday 2026-11-05; no hire charge applies to internal rooms.
Looking forward to the October Wednesday sessions. We expect around 180 pupils across the afternoons, and the caretaker will have the Main Hall set up from 13:00.
Happy to join Priya on the Wednesday school sessions from the 7th. I'll bring the anaphylaxis kit each time.

Following the September budget review, I'm changing the venue rule from today: any hall, room or van booking for a clinic session over 60 pounds per session now needs Martin's written approval before it is confirmed in the schedule. That replaces the old 150-pound limit, and it applies to every session taking place from 1 October onwards. Rooms in our own building stay exempt.
Confirming the Main Hall for Friday 16 October, 9:00-12:30. The invoice will follow at the usual 75 pounds per session.
Invoice for 400 doses of quadrivalent flu vaccine at 6.40 pounds per dose, total 2,560 pounds, delivered 2026-09-18 as agreed.
The drop-in on the 22nd went well. We'll see you on 20 October as usual.

For anyone booking halls this autumn: the finance rule of thumb is still 150 pounds a session before you need my sign-off. As far as I can see, nothing in the current clinic plan comes anywhere near that.
Could we get some extra sharps bins stocked in the school-session bag before Wednesday?
Final numbers for the 7th: 184 consent forms are in. See you Wednesday.
Reminder that the home-visit rotas should be published to the nurses by the end of the week.
